definitions.explanation: Biological species — the basic unit of taxonomy. Also used more loosely as a noun or counter for 'kind' or 'type', especially in technical writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{種|しゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new species has been discovered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧|きぐ}{種|しゅ}→絶滅危惧種：04642_zetsumetsukigushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to protect endangered species.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数百|すうひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧{種|しゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Several hundred species of plants live in this forest.

notes:
Reading しゅ refers primarily to the biological concept of species. The same kanji read たね means 'seed' and is a separate entry. As a counter, {種|しゅ} counts kinds or species (3{種|しゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ = three species/kinds of plants).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧|きぐ}{種|しゅ}→絶滅危惧種：04642_zetsumetsukigushu⟧: endangered species
- ⟦{外来|がいらい}{種|しゅ}→外来種：23243_gairaishu⟧: non-native/invasive species
- {在来|ざいらい}{種|しゅ}: native species
- {新種|しんしゅ}: new species
- ⟦{人種|じんしゅ}→人種：03354_jinshu⟧: race (of people)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: kind, type — everyday word for varieties of anything
- ⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧: variety, breed — for plants and animals (especially cultivated)
- ⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧: seed — same kanji, different reading, separate entry
